sponsor_technologies.name: Zetaris

sponsor_technologies.name: Meterless

description: PolyToken explains which model fits an Indian-language workload and why: measured token counts, dated provider prices, Nemotron reasoning, Zetaris SQL and checked evidence receipts.
demo_question: Which model fits our users and our budget, and why?
limitations: Only GPT-OSS passed the serving probe; stand-in evidence does not transfer.
demo_narration: Narration is an AI voice generated from the author's own voice with ElevenLabs.
deck_submission: Submitted through the hackathon form; local artifacts are not distributed in the repository.
demo_mode: Checked saved-run replay on synthetic companies; no external provider calls.
uploads: Live mode required. One bundled synthetic Telugu chat template completed via the launcher with 141 independently rechecked claims; arbitrary exports, voice and remote deployments remain unverified.
